usedFor: Shopify holds orders and products, and Jandi receives a message through “Send Jandi Webhook Message” for the team.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Send Jandi Webhook Message” in Jandi
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order needs a quick look, and the message puts it in front of the team.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify checks on a schedule, so its Jandi message can lag behind the cart.
